page.overview:
Who is Baroness?

Baroness is portrayed by Úrsula Corberó.

As a member of the terrorist organization Cobra, the Baroness has committed many ruthless acts. Her most notorious crime is having killed a member of parliament along with 200 civilians on the same train in order to influence an election. Besides this, she has also been involved in bombings, assassinations and civil unrest across the globe.

Baroness links up with Kenta and his organization as part of a plan to destroy the Arashikage Clan and claim their most prized artifact: the Jewel of the Sun. This jewel is said to have been a gift from the goddess of the sun but is a powerful weapon in the wrong hands. Upon arrival in Japan, Baroness quickly meets up with Kenta. The two of them are confronted by Snake Eyes, a man with a mysterious past that Kenta has hired to infiltrate the clan and steal the jewel. He tells them that he didn't sign up for terrorists, but Baroness warns him that it's a little late for him to start growing a conscience. The two of them remind him of their leverage over him: they can give him the man who killed his father. After he leaves, Kenta tells the Baroness to trust him that Snake Eyes will complete the job. "He'd better," she warns him, "or I kill you both."

Snake Eyes does indeed complete the job and is rewarded as promised. Kenta and Baroness then head for the Arashikage Castle to launch their attack. Once there, however, Kenta double-crosses Baroness, declaring that he is going to keep the Jewel instead of handing it over to Cobra. Aggravated, Baroness warns Kenta that Cobra will destroy him. She then accepts an offer of a temporary alliance from Scarlett of G.I. Joe to work together to take down Kenta.
